name: Form 3 Biology: Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration
subject: Biology
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to distinguish between aerobic and anaerobic respiration
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to write word equations for respiration
learningActivities: Discussion: why do we breathe heavily after exercise?
Demonstration: teacher uses a diagram to explain respiration
Group work: learners compare aerobic and anaerobic respiration
Application: learners explain respiration in yeast and muscles
keyPoints: Aerobic respiration uses oxygen: glucose + oxygen -> carbon dioxide + water + energy
Anaerobic respiration occurs without oxygen and produces less energy
Anaerobic respiration in muscles produces lactic acid
commonMisconceptions: Thinking breathing is the same as respiration
lessonEvaluation: Learners write word equations and compare aerobic and anaerobic respiration.
teacherReflection: Clear understanding. Practical on fermentation next lesson.
